tasks.title: BayReady: Chat home tiles Appointment status and Today's services show nothing when tapped
tasks.brief:
Evidence: Chanh, real RO page, v3.21: tap tile Appointment status or Today's services and nothing appears (no user line, no error). Find a car works. Code path: content.js home tile handler (search w.querySelectorAll('.tile')) -> runJob('builtin-xtime-status' or 'builtin-xtime-day') = post({type:'run_route', id}); background.js case 'run_route' -> runRouteTask(...).catch(() => {}) (silent); routes.js runRouteTaskInner has `if (!route) return;` (silent); runRouteTask/waitQuiet/withSched can wait before the first addLog so the tap shows nothing meanwhile. Say which suspect it was: 1) port to background dead (stale tab), 2) route id not found, 3) wait before first log, 4) error swallowed by .catch.
Done when this passes: Start from repo giusemc1988/bayready main (v3.21.4), branch tiles-fix, bump to 3.21.5, change ONLY content.js/background.js/routes.js as needed. 1) node scripts/bayready-gate.mjs (from stock-predict) prints GATE: green. 2) Tapping each of the two tiles shows a user line at once, then the result or a clear error message within 5 s (never silent). Do NOT release, do NOT touch bayready-latest.zip, do NOT merge: open a PR and write PR:, GATE:, and the suspect number in the RESULT file.
tasks.progress: picked up T18 (bayready tiles show nothing when tapped); reading the tile path in content.js/background.js/routes.js from main v3.21.4
tasks.result: DONE PR: https://github.com/giusemc1988/bayready/pull/5 GATE: green Suspect: 3 (wait before first log) BayReady 3.21.5 (from main 3.21.4, branch tiles-fix). Tapping Appointment status or Today's services showed nothing: runRouteTaskInner waited in waitQuiet (silent up to 7.5s for a background TIS read) before the first user line, and the content.js 5s safety net never fired because state.running was already true from that TIS read. Changed only content.js, routes.js (+ manifest/changelog version bump). routes.js: route lookup and the user line now run before waitQuiet, so a tap shows its line at once; a missing route errors at once too. content.js: the 5s runJob timer now fires on no-log alone, even when state.running is already true. Checks (real output): node --check OK on content.js, routes.js, background.js. Verification test (vm harness, ~/workspace/bayready-work/v3215-test/test-tiles-fix.js): 7/7 pass — user line before waitQuiet for both tiles, missing route errors at once without waiting, 5s alert fires even when state.running is true. node bayready-gate.mjs (stock-predict, --prev 3.21.4 manifest): GATE: green. Not released, bayready-latest.zip untouched, not merged (reviewer merges per pipeline). LESSON: A "did not start" safety timer must check only whether anything was logged, never whether the panel already looks busy — a background read sets running=true, so a timer gated on !running never fires and the tap stays silent.

Changed only tests/enrich-pick.test.js (2 lines): path src/routes.js -> routes.js, and the first comment line now says run from the repo root. No code changed, no version bump, no extension file touched. Checks (real output): before — node tests/enrich-pick.test.js: Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '.../src/routes.js'. After — node tests/enrich-pick.test.js exits 0 and prints 'enrichPick: all tests passed'. tasks.title: BayReady: page timers keep running and throwing after the extension is updated (stale tab)
tasks.brief:
Evidence: content.js has 17 setInterval calls that run for the life of the page (e.g. lines ~4823 roslot refresh, ~6848 tload bars, ~7368 cvPreScanBar, ~7493 RO watcher, ~5326 port ping). Only one watcher (staleIv, ~line 4262) notices the extension was updated (chrome.runtime.id gone) and it only shows a banner and hides the panel; the other timers keep firing and call chrome.runtime.sendMessage / chrome.storage, which throw 'Extension context invalidated' every tick on every stale tab.
Done when this passes: Branch stale-timers from repo giusemc1988/bayready main (v3.21.4), bump to 3.21.6 only if 3.21.5 (task tiles fix) is not yet in main, otherwise 3.21.5+1. Change ONLY content.js. When staleIv sees the context is dead it must clear every page timer (e.g. route page timers through one helper that records ids, then clear them all there). Do not reload the tab automatically (3.21.3 rule: never reload a tab the user may be typing in). Gate: node scripts/bayready-gate.mjs (from stock-predict) prints GATE: green and tests/enrich-pick.test.js still passes if it runs. Do NOT release, do NOT touch bayready-latest.zip, do NOT merge: open a PR and write PR:, GATE: and the list of timers you routed through the helper in the RESULT file.

tasks.brief:
Full request from chanh:
BayReady — sửa layout theo hình anh gửi (đang chạy v3.21.11). Chỉ sửa 3 chỗ dưới đây. Không đổi màu, không đổi style board, không bỏ tính năng nào, không đổi thứ tự gì khác.

1. Chữ bị lấn ra khỏi ô (tab History):
Trong tab History, ô Declined (màu đỏ) hiện mô tả công việc dài (ví dụ job phanh trước). Chữ chạm / lấn ra mép ô, và góc ô cong nhiều hơn các ô khác trên cùng màn hình. Làm cho chữ nằm gọn trong ô, có khoảng thở, và độ cong góc giống các ô còn lại (các ô cân đối). Kiểm tra luôn các ô khác: ô nào chữ chạm hay lấn ra mép thì sửa cho chữ nằm gọn trong ô. Chỉ sửa ô, không đổi nội dung chữ.

2. MPI — chỉ còn 4 bánh:
Tab MPI hiện có 4 ô mỗi trục (trước + sau) cộng thêm lốp spare ở giữa. Đổi thành chỉ còn 4 bánh xe: 2 bánh trước, 2 bánh sau. Bỏ hẳn lốp spare. Bỏ hẳn các ô phanh (cả 2 trục). Mỗi trục chỉ hiện 2 bánh của nó, không còn gì khác. Nút "Enter into Inspect" và ô Recommend giữ nguyên như cũ.

3. Bảng Appointment status — nhỏ lại, vừa màn hình, không cần scroll:
Bảng Appointment status (các ô: Total today, Not Arrived, With Advisor, Checked In, Inspecting, Servicing, Hold for Approval, Final Inspection) đang quá to — anh phải phóng to extension hoặc scroll lên xuống mới xem hết. Làm các ô và số nhỏ lại, cân đối, để cả bảng vừa trong panel, không cần scroll, không cần phóng to extension, nhưng số vẫn đọc được và mọi số/nhãn vẫn hiện đầy đủ (không bị cắt). Giữ nguyên bố cục, màu, thứ tự — chỉ gọn lại.

Xong thì đưa bản build lại cho Milo (milo-shared) để Milo kiểm tra trước khi lên máy.

tasks.title: BayReady 3.21.16: fix silent tiles (if still broken) and stale-tab timers, one PR on top of 3.21.15
tasks.brief:
Chanh approved this on 2026-11-15 ("giao cho Milo lam luon"). It replaces the two old proposals T20 and T26 (their briefs named a stale base). Two small fixes in ONE pull request.
BASE: the newest build is v3.21.15 on branch layout-fix-4 (open PR #14 in giusemc1988/bayready, NOT merged, main is still 3.21.4). Start a new branch fixes-3.21.16 from layout-fix-4 and open the pull request against layout-fix-4. Never push to main or layout-fix-4 itself.
FIX 1 (tiles that stay silent): in content.js runJob, the 5-second safety message must fire when the chat log has not grown, even when state.running is already true (a background TIS read sets it). In routes.js runRouteTaskInner, look up the route and write the user line to the chat BEFORE waitQuiet, so a tap never shows nothing. First check by reading the code whether 3.21.15 already does both; if it does, skip this fix and say so in RESULT.
FIX 2 (stale tab timers): content.js has about 17 setInterval timers. Only the staleIv watcher notices the extension was updated (chrome.runtime.id gone) and it only shows a banner. Route the page timers through one helper that records their ids, and when staleIv sees the context is dead clear them all. Do not reload the tab automatically. In RESULT list the timers you routed through the helper.
Version 3.21.16, changelog EN+VI, node --check on every js file, gate: node milo-shared\bayready-gate.mjs <checkout> --prev 3.21.15 must print GATE: green. Do NOT release, do NOT touch bayready-latest.zip, do NOT merge. Write RESULT right after opening the PR (PR: and GATE: lines).

tasks.title: BayReady: tapped tiles answer at once + stale tabs stop their timers (2 small fixes, one PR)
tasks.brief:
Chanh said do it (2026-11-14 evening). BASE: repo main is still 3.21.4. The newest code is the open PR #14 branch layout-fix-4 (3.21.15) or a higher zip in milo-shared. Branch from the branch/zip with the HIGHEST version (check manifest.json), open ONE PR against main, say in the PR which base you used. Version = next free number above the highest one you find (also check milo-shared zips). Changelog EN+VI.

FIX 1 (tiles): tapping home tile Appointment status or Today's services shows nothing when the extension is busy with a background TIS read. In routes.js runRouteTaskInner: look up the route and write the user line BEFORE waitQuiet (a missing route errors at once). In content.js runJob (home tiles): the 5s 'did not start' alert must fire on no-log alone, even when state.running is already true. First check by reading the code whether the newest build already does this; if yes skip FIX 1 and say so.

FIX 2 (stale timers): after an extension update, an open old tab keeps ~17 setInterval timers that throw 'Extension context invalidated' every tick. content.js: when the existing stale watcher (staleIv) sees chrome.runtime.id is gone it must clear every page timer (route page timers through one helper that records ids, then clear them all there). Do NOT reload the tab automatically.

Checks: node --check on all js, gate green with --prev, tests/enrich-pick.test.js passes. Write RESULT right after opening the PR. Do not merge, do not release, do not touch bayready-latest.zip.

tasks.brief:
Full request from chanh:
# Role & Context
You are building a new UI module and DOM automation feature for **BayReady**, a browser extension designed for automotive technicians working inside **Xtime** (MPI / Multi-Point Inspection workflow). 

# Objective
Build a fast, low-click **MPI Quick-Fill & Recommendations Panel** inside the MPI section of the BayReady extension. The design must strictly adhere to BayReady's existing main theme (colors, typography, border-radius, spacing, and dark/light styling).

# Functional Requirements

## 1. Tires & Brakes Quick-Click Matrix (Max 6 Clicks Total)
Create a dedicated, compact card/box titled **"Tires & Brakes"** designed as a zero-typing fallback when voice input is unavailable.
- **Goal:** A technician must be able to populate all 4 tires and both brake axles into Xtime in **6 clicks total** (1 click per item).
- **Layout:** Clean 2-column or grid layout matching the main theme:
 - **Tires (4 buttons):** `Left Front (LF)`, `Right Front (RF)`, `Right Rear (RR)`, `Left Rear (LR)`
 - **Brakes (2 buttons):** `Front Brakes`, `Rear Brakes`
- **Interaction & Behavior:**
 - Each button should allow quick selection/toggling of standard measurement presets (e.g., tread depth in `/32"` and brake pad thickness in `mm`, with sensible defaults or quick-step increments on click/cycle) and immediately inject/sync the value into the corresponding Xtime MPI form fields.
 - Show clear visual feedback (active state, checkmark, or color badge) once a tire/brake position has been filled so the tech can track progress at a glance.

## 2. One-Click MPI Recommendations Grid
Create a second dedicated card/box titled **"Quick Recommendations"** containing a grid of compact, clickable preset tiles.
- **Default Priority Behavior:** Every recommendation item defaults to **Yellow (Recommended Soon)** when clicked.
- **Red Priority Override:** Each tile must include a small, non-intrusive toggle/badge/corner icon (e.g., a small red dot/flag button) allowing the tech to mark/switch that specific item to **Red (Immediate Attention)** before or upon adding, without cluttering the tile.
- **Click Action:** Clicking a tile automatically injects the item title, priority status (`Yellow` by default, or `Red` if flagged), and its pre-written customer-friendly recommendation text directly into Xtime's MPI recommendation fields. Show a subtle toast or active highlight confirming it was added.
